/websites-for/roofers.description: Hand-coded websites for roofing firms: tap-to-call, a page for each job, your areas and proof of your work. Fixed price agreed before we start.

faqs.q: How fast should a roofing website load?
faqs.a: It should load quickly on a weak mobile signal, because people often search from vans, driveways and gardens. A lightweight, hand-coded page loads while a heavy WordPress theme is still thinking, and Google measures that speed too.

faqs.q: Do I own my roofing website?
faqs.a: Yes. Every site is written from scratch with no page-builder, theme or plugins, and you own the code and the domain outright. You get a fixed price before any work starts.

/websites-for/landscapers.title: Websites for Landscapers & Garden Designers
/websites-for/landscapers.description: Hand-coded websites for landscapers and garden designers: a portfolio that shows your best work, clear services and easy enquiries. Fixed price.

faqs.q: What should a landscaper's website include?
faqs.a: A portfolio built around a few complete projects, clear separate pages for design, build and maintenance, and the areas you cover. It also needs a short introduction about who you are and a simple way to get in touch, such as a short form or WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Why does a landscaping website need to be fast?
faqs.a: Landscaping sites are image-heavy, which is where slow sites suffer most. Hand-coded pages with properly sized images stay quick on mobile even with a big portfolio.

/speed-test.title: Free Website Speed Test
/speed-test.description: Paste in your site and get its real Google PageSpeed score, live. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored. See how fast your site loads on mobile.

/guides/is-a-website-worth-it-for-trades.description: Work out if a website pays for itself: the profit on a typical job against the cost of the site. Put in your own numbers and see how many jobs it takes.

faqs.q: When is a website not worth it for a tradesman?
faqs.a: If you are booked solid for months from repeat customers and word of mouth, and don't want to grow or move up to better-paid work, a website won't change much yet. Keep your Google Business Profile up to date and revisit the sum when that changes.
